name: M5.PrefixPartition.count_terminal
statement: ∀ (α : Type) [DecidableEq α] (W : Finset (List α)) (m : ℕ) (p : List α), (∀ q ∈ W, q.length = m) → p.length = m → M5.PrefixPartition.count W p = (if p ∈ W then 1 else 0)
guidance: At equal length List.IsPrefix.eq_of_length shows prefix iff equality. Rewrite filtered W to singleton p or empty. No assumption that W is nonempty. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.
